title: Very good experience
review_text:
I have been a Groww customer since past more than 5 years and I am very satisfied with Groww - wonderful interface, ease of use, prompt support. Recently I saw that Groww has introduced global investing through US stocks and US based ETFs. This is a good option for global diversification considering investment through mutual fund route is almost closed since early 2022.

It was my suggestion to Groww’s team to introduce UCITS ETF (ETFs which are not US based) since this would avoid high withholding tax on dividend as well as Estate tax imposed by US. Also, dividends of UCITS are reinvested automatically inside the Fund. Platforms such as IndMoney do offer UCITS ETF. Since Groww is a very progressive organisation and takes pride in always keeping its ears to the ground and giving customer satisfaction highest importance, I hope Groww team takes note of this suggestion.
